messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: EU canary group 'eu-canary' healthchecks > 30% 502s after canary rollout (deploy/serving:v0.22). Paging on-call.

deploy-bot: started rollout 3m ago, canary at 20% traffic (rollout id: r-2026-03-17-4822). Logs show upstream 502s from tokenizer service.

alice: seeing the same in dashboards — tailing logs shows `tokenizer: error parsing chunk` between 02:01-02:04 UTC. Impact seems EU-only so far.

raj: i’m oncall, joining. Can we throttle canary to 0% or kill the feature flag?

katie: if we flip the feature flag it should fallback to tokenizer v1.8. Command: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/kill/serving.tokenizer.v2`

raj: doing flag kill now.

raj: :white_check_mark: flag kill API responded 200. Canaries should drop to fallback immediately. Monitoring...

alice: traffic dropped to fallback — errors dropping in EU. Good. But we still need a post-deploy hotfix: root cause looks like a single commit that changed chunking boundaries (commit abc1234).

dan: i can cut a tiny patch revert and push a new canary. Prefer revert of that single commit rather than patching tokenizer in prod.

katie: agree. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/pulls/742 — revert abc1234, CI runs fast.

raj: can someone validate no customer-facing config change needed? Customer impact so far: intermittent 502s for some EU requests ~02:01-02:06 UTC. No data loss. Support notified.

deploy-bot: CI green for revert PR, ready to patch. Suggest canary 5% for 5m then ramp.

alice: quick deploy steps (copy):
```
# merge revert PR and trigger release
git merge --no-ff revert/abc1234 && ./scripts/release-canary --id r-hotfix-4822 --percent 5
```

dan: merging and kicking canary now.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started r-hotfix-4822 -> canary 5%.

raj: monitoring logs and SLO dashboards. EU 502s trending down after new canary behind revert.

alice: after 6m canary at 5% looks healthy, errors ~0.5% vs 6% earlier. ramping to 50%.

deploy-bot: ramp complete to 50% then 100% over 10m as per policy.

raj: full rollout complete, feature flag remains killed until end of postmortem. Support: telling customers "brief EU errors, fixed via quick revert; no data lost".

katie: filing incident ticket and will schedule postmortem. Assigning to release owner and runtime team.

dan: thumbs — will add commit-level regression test for chunk boundary case.

alice: nice work everyone. will hand off to next on-call for overnight watch.

raj: handing off to @dan-night for 02:30-08:30 UTC. all good to close once postmortem is created. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: breach mitigated, rollback applied, canary ramped, feature flag held.

katie: created incident doc: https://infra.internal/incidents/4822003333-canary-tokenizer-hotfix — will include timeline and action items.
